knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The screening is checked before any contact with a learner.
The written policy sets the location. Changes go to the business first.
The business channel and agreed hours protect both the learner and the tutor.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks a screening record for type, expiry date and check date for a named tutor
Assessor presents a request for a private session and observes the candidate apply the written policy and record it
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate. Child-safety content needs a reviewer before approval.
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate has contact with a learner while a required check is missing or expired
The candidate agrees to a private, unrecorded or off-policy arrangement with a learner
The candidate uses a personal channel to contact a learner
